fields.text: Make a photoreal cinematic character still from a short person brief, lighting and frame. MiniMax H3 Image at 1K ($0.02/image). Change the person, light or frame — sample details live only in those inputs. No prompt-writing call. Inspect likeness to the brief; this is key-art, not a photograph of a real person. Saved gallery output is pending a cheap QC run.

A fictional 40-year-old piano tuner, cropped silver hair, wire-rim glasses slightly down the nose, linen shirtsleeves rolled, one red felt mute in her right hand. Calm listening expression, wind-worn hands. One person only. No text, logos or extra people.

fields.options:
single warm work lamp from camera-left, piano strings soft in the background
cool hallway spill plus one practical, dark backstage
hard rim light from behind, bounce fill on the face, black void
overcast window from camera-right, dusty air, muted wood
fields.selected: single warm work lamp from camera-left, piano strings soft in the background
